name: quantifier_truth
description: Determine whether all/some/no/exactly-one members of a finite set have a property; control copies the queried property.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randint(3,6); color=random.choice(['red','blue','green']); other=[x for x in ['red','blue','green'] if x!=color]; k=random.randint(0,n)
 vals=[color]*k+[random.choice(other) for _ in range(n-k)];random.shuffle(vals)
 q=random.choice(['every','some','no','exactly one'])
 truth={'every':k==n,'some':k>0,'no':k==0,'exactly one':k==1}[q]
 prefix='The complete collection contains balls with these colors: '+', '.join(vals)+'. Claim: '+q+' ball is '+color+'.'
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+' Is the claim true? Answer yes or no:', 'answer':' '+('yes' if truth else 'no')})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+' Which color is mentioned in the claim? Answer:', 'answer':' '+color})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
